item.malumbuddycards.buddycard_malum9.de: Not to be confused with the powder.
item.malumbuddycards.buddycard_malum10.d: A golden personality waiting to be unearthed.
item.malumbuddycards.buddycard_malum16.d: Don't look at them for too long.
item.malumbuddycards.buddycard_malum18.d: He shares your pain in more ways then one.
item.malumbuddycards.buddycard_malum22.d: He's holding on to many of the soul.

 -Packs contain one less foil than usual
malumbuddycards.gui.geas.pact_of_the_bul: Is there ever too much of a good thing

 -Packs contain three more cards than usual

malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.childish_: Ever wanted to drain that childlike wonder out of annoying little brats? By making use of the properties of Buddysteel, now you can! That said, I can definitely find some good uses for their spirits.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.ring_of_y: I've been going through my childish spirits too fast lately. It takes time to find new victims, and the less I need to reap, the less I hear their screams at night. This should make gathering them more efficient.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.childish_: A bit of an odd choice, I'll admit, but once my collection grew large enough, the power of the medallions felt too strong to not take advantage of. By giving up my belt, I can easily wear three. Now just to find something new to hold up my pants.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.triplicat: I've been thinking about it, and with the current power of my medallions, I think they can compensate a lot of strength. I've altered the brooch so that I can handle the power of the medals myself, and the right medals can probably offset that cost.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.childish_: Childish arcana is not the most potent, yet is very chaotic and silly in nature. They aren't even that useful.

These childish spirits can be found within the most annoying of youth. It also is quite the nuisance to collect, needing specific trinkets to draw them out properly. It's probably not worth the trouble for those not interested in collecting Buddycards, but for those who are, I've found a few ways to use them to help in completing my collection.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.buddycard: For the collectors of Buddycards, you can create some unique packs with the usage of old cards, some paper to bind to, and a bunch of childish spirits. Once opened, the buddycards themselves are no different then other buddycards.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.rune_of_w: The Rune of Whimsy uses the power of childish spirits to double childish spoils, allowing the user to reap the souls of the youth with greater efficiency.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.rancid_sl: Some collectors may be crazy enough to want not just the best quality of Buddycards, but the worst of them as well. By infusing grading sleeves with the power of rotten essence, you can use these sleeves on already graded cards, and the value can only go down.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.rite_of_t: A simple rite, while active you will have higher chances to open rarer Buddycards, but quantity will lower.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.rune_of_l: The Rune of Lucky Rip bears the rite effect of its namesake, granting Lucky Rip to its wearer at half potency, increasing your chances of finding rare buddycards, but quantity may lower. (Rites to be added in later version of Malum Buddycards)
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.rite_of_t: A simple rite, while active packs you open will contain more Buddycards, but rarer cards appear less often.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.rune_of_b: The Rune of Bulk Boon bears the rite effect of its namesake, granting Bulk Boon to its wearer at half potency, adding an extra card to each pack, but rarer cards will appear slightly less often. (Rites to be added in later version of Malum Buddycards)
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.rite_of_g: An advanced rite, while active nearby Graders will grade with greater speed.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.rite_of_y: An advanced rite, while active nearby mobs will revert to a childlike state, including those who normally may not appear as children.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.void.ring: I've grown far too used to the screams, but this ring will let me gather even more childish spirits. Why should one ever stop? The faster I can gather, the more my collection grows!
malum.gui.book.entry.void.rune_of_nostal: To return to what once was
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.void.rune: The Rune of Nostalgia reverts the user's body to a childlike state, regaining their youthful vigor and allowing them to fit in smaller spaces.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.void.null: When passed through the Well, something strange happens to the Buddycard packs I forged with my spirits. At first, I thought it may be a new set, but after opening a few, that doesn't seem to be the case.

I didn't notice it at first, but I will occasionally find new cards that appear quite different than what I have come to expect. Many of these new cards depict resources that I have only discovered via the Well, and they seem to have something different than the typical Luminis and Rainbow foils, though the scanner cannot tell them apart. For now I will call these variations Night and Void foils.
